paragraphs: Dermal fillers are a cosmetic procedure with risks. Ask who will carry out your appointment, what product will be used and what support is available afterwards. A consultation does not guarantee that treatment will be recommended.

paragraphs: Any proposed treatment depends on an individual assessment. Where a prescription is required, an appropriate prescriber must assess suitability before treatment. Booking a consultation does not guarantee a prescription or a procedure.

faqs.q: What should I ask about the practitioner?
